# FORMA v6.0.0 — complete reference

> Generated from the same source as the CSS. 126 components · 59 themes · 1770 contrast checks (all pass).

FORMA is a CSS design system with an optional JS behaviour layer. Follow these rules when generating UI.

1. **Use only FORMA classes that exist.** Look them up (llms-full.txt, forma-spec.json, or the MCP tool `get_component`). Never invent classes such as `btn-blue` or `card-shadow`.
2. **Never hard-code colors, fonts, radii or spacing.** Use tokens: `var(--accent)`, `var(--text-secondary)`, `var(--space-4)`, `var(--radius-lg)`.
3. **Native elements first.** Modals are `<dialog class="dialog">` opened with `data-forma-open="id"`; menus and popovers use the `popover` attribute + `popovertarget`; accordions are `<details class="disclosure">`; checkboxes are `<input type="checkbox" class="checkbox">`.
4. **State lives in ARIA attributes, not classes:** `aria-selected`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-current="page"`, `aria-invalid="true"`, `aria-expanded`. Tabs need `role="tablist"/"tab"/"tabpanel"` and `data-forma="tabs"` on the wrapper.
5. **Every control needs a name:** `<label for>` for inputs; `aria-label` for icon-only buttons; `alt` for images.
6. **Icons:** `<svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-NAME"/></svg>`.
7. **Modes and themes:** `data-mode="light|dark"` (omit to follow the OS) and `data-theme="<id>"` after loading `themes/<id>.css`. Never use `data-theme="dark"` — that was v5.
8. **Layout:** `.container`, `.stack`, `.cluster`, `.split`, `.grid` (`--min`), `.grid-2/3/4`, `.dash` + `.span-N`; gaps via `.gap-N` or `--gap`.
9. **Charts:** `<figure class="chart" data-forma="chart" data-type="line|area|bar|donut" data-labels="…" data-series='[{"name":"A","values":[…]}]'>` with a `.chart-canvas` child. Never two y-axes.
10. **Validate before you finish:** run `npx @nage/forma lint file.html` or the MCP tool `validate_html`.

Components: 126 · Themes: 59 · Docs: https://forma-design-five.vercel.app/llms-full.txt


## Install
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@nage/forma@6.0.0/dist/forma.min.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@nage/forma@6.0.0/dist/forma.min.js" defer></script>
<!-- optional theme -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@nage/forma@6.0.0/dist/themes/swiss.css">
<html data-theme="swiss" data-mode="dark">
```

## Tokens
Color tokens (each is one `light-dark()` value, recomputed per theme): `--bg-base`, `--bg-surface`, `--bg-elevated`, `--bg-subtle`, `--bg-hover`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-tertiary`, `--text-disabled`, `--border-control`, `--accent`, `--accent-contrast`, `--accent-hover`, `--accent-text`, `--error`, `--success`, `--warning`, `--info`, `--on-error`, `--on-success`, `--on-warning`, `--on-info`, `--data-1`, `--data-2`, `--data-3`, `--data-4`, `--data-5`, `--data-6`, `--data-7`, `--data-8`.
Derived: `--border-faint|default|muted|strong`, `--accent-muted`, `--accent-subtle`, `--{error,success,warning,info}-muted`, `--{…}-border`, `--shadow-xs…xl`, `--focus-ring`.
Use `--accent` for fills/indicators and `--accent-text` for accent-colored text; `--accent-contrast` is text on an accent fill.

- `--font-display`: 'Cormorant Variable', 'Cormorant', 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
- `--font-ui`: 'Syne Variable', 'Syne', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
- `--font-mono`: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
- `--weight-light`: 300
- `--weight-regular`: 400
- `--weight-medium`: 500
- `--weight-semibold`: 600
- `--weight-display`: 300
- `--text-2xs`: 0.6875rem
- `--text-xs`: 0.75rem
- `--text-sm`: 0.875rem
- `--text-base`: 1rem
- `--text-md`: 1.125rem
- `--text-lg`: 1.375rem

- `--text-5xl`: clamp(3rem, 1.8rem + 5vw, 5.5rem)
- `--leading-none`: 1

## Typography helpers
`.t-display-xl|lg|md|sm` (display serif), `.t-heading`, `.t-subheading`, `.t-body`, `.t-body-sm`, `.t-label`, `.t-caption`, `.t-meta`, `.t-mono`, colors `.t-primary|secondary|tertiary|accent|error|success|warning|info`, `.t-num`, `.t-truncate`, `.t-clamp-2|3`.

## JavaScript (optional)
Auto-initialises `[data-forma]` elements (also ones added later). Global `Forma` (IIFE) or `import * as Forma from '@nage/forma'`.
- `Forma.mode.set('light'|'dark'|'system')`, `Forma.mode.toggle()` · `Forma.theme.set(id)`
- `Forma.dialog.open(id)`, `Forma.dialog.close(id, value)`, `Forma.confirm({ title, text, danger })` → Promise<boolean>
- `Forma.toast({ type, title, text, duration, action })`, `Forma.toast.success(title, text)`
- `Forma.chart(el, { type, labels, series, format })`, `Forma.tabs(el)`, `Forma.combobox(el)`, `Forma.datepicker(el)`, `Forma.wizard(el)`, `Forma.validate(form)`, `Forma.chat(el)`
- Events bubble as `forma:<name>` (forma:change, forma:tab, forma:select, forma:mode, forma:theme…)

---

## Button  ·  Core
Actions. Eight intents, three sizes, icon-only, loading and grouped forms.

- base: `.btn`
- variants: `.btn-primary` `.btn-secondary` `.btn-accent` `.btn-soft` `.btn-ghost` `.btn-outline` `.btn-destructive` `.btn-danger` `.btn-link`
- sizes: `.btn-sm` `.btn-md` `.btn-lg`
- modifiers: `.btn-icon` `.btn-block` `.is-loading`
- parts: `.btn-group`

```html
<div class="cluster">
  <button class="btn btn-primary">Primary</button>
  <button class="btn">Secondary</button>
  <button class="btn btn-accent">Accent</button>
  <button class="btn btn-soft">Soft</button>
  <button class="btn btn-ghost">Ghost</button>
  <button class="btn btn-outline">Outline</button>
  <button class="btn btn-destructive">Delete</button>
  <button class="btn btn-danger">Delete forever</button>
  <button class="btn btn-link">Link</button>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Icon-only buttons need aria-label.
- Loading: set aria-busy="true" — the label stays in the accessibility tree while hidden visually.
- Toggle groups use aria-pressed; Forma.js keeps it in sync when data-forma="toggle-group" is set.
- Use <a class="btn"> only for navigation.

From v5: `btn-icon (standalone)` → `btn btn-icon`

---

## Badge  ·  Core
Compact, non-interactive status labels.

- base: `.badge`
- variants: `.badge-accent` `.badge-success` `.badge-warning` `.badge-error` `.badge-info` `.badge-outline` `.badge-solid`
- modifiers: `.badge-pill` `.badge-dot` `.badge-mono` `.badge-plan`

```html
<div class="cluster">
  <span class="badge">Draft</span>
  <span class="badge badge-accent">New</span>
  <span class="badge badge-success badge-dot">Published</span>
  <span class="badge badge-warning">Review</span>
  <span class="badge badge-error">Failed</span>
  <span class="badge badge-info">Beta</span>
  <span class="badge badge-outline">Archived</span>
  <span class="badge badge-solid badge-pill">12</span>
  <span class="badge badge-plan badge-accent">Pro</span>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Color is never the only signal: badges always carry text.

From v5: `plan-badge pb-pro` → `badge badge-plan badge-accent`

---

## Tag & Chip  ·  Core
Tags are toggleable filters; chips are removable values.

- base: `.tag`
- states: `aria-pressed` `.is-active`
- parts: `.chip` `.chip-remove`

```html
<div class="stack gap-3">
  <div class="cluster" role="group" aria-label="Filter by medium">
    <button class="tag" aria-pressed="true">All</button>
    <button class="tag" aria-pressed="false">Painting</button>
    <button class="tag" aria-pressed="false">Sculpture</button>
    <button class="tag" aria-pressed="false">Digital</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cluster">
    <span class="chip">Qwen3-14B <button class="chip-remove" aria-label="Remove Qwen3-14B">×</button></span>
    <span class="chip">SFT <button class="chip-remove" aria-label="Remove SFT">×</button></span>
  </div>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Tags are buttons with aria-pressed.
- Each chip-remove button names the value it removes.

---

## Avatar  ·  Core
People and entities — round or square, six sizes, initials or image, grouped.

- base: `.avatar`
- sizes: `.avatar-xs` `.avatar-sm` `.avatar-md` `.avatar-lg` `.avatar-xl` `.avatar-2xl`
- variants: `.avatar-accent` `.avatar-info` `.avatar-success` `.avatar-warning`
- modifiers: `.avatar-square` `.avatar-status`
- parts: `.avatar-group`

```html
<div class="cluster gap-4">
  <span class="avatar avatar-xs">A</span>
  <span class="avatar avatar-sm">ÖA</span>
  <span class="avatar avatar-md avatar-accent">EV</span>
  <span class="avatar avatar-lg avatar-square avatar-info">CK</span>
  <span class="avatar avatar-xl avatar-status">SY</span>
  <div class="avatar-group">
    <span class="avatar avatar-sm avatar-accent">F</span>
    <span class="avatar avatar-sm avatar-info">C</span>
    <span class="avatar avatar-sm avatar-success">E</span>
    <span class="avatar avatar-sm">+4</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Images need alt text; decorative initials next to a visible name can be aria-hidden.

From v5: `picon picon-lg` → `avatar avatar-lg avatar-square`

## Divider  ·  Core
Separation through restraint: three weights, vertical and labeled.

- base: `.divider`
- variants: `.divider-faint` `.divider-strong` `.divider-vertical`
- parts: `.divider-label`

```html
<div>
  <hr class="divider">
  <div class="divider-label">or continue with email</div>
  <p class="t-body-sm">Left <span class="divider-vertical" role="separator"></span> Right</p>
</div>
```

## Icon  ·  Core
Stroke icons from the forma-icons.svg sprite (Lucide, ISC). Six sizes, semantic colors.

- base: `.fi`
- sizes: `.fi-xs` `.fi-sm` `.fi-md` `.fi-lg` `.fi-xl` `.fi-2xl`
- variants: `.fi-primary` `.fi-secondary` `.fi-tertiary` `.fi-accent` `.fi-success` `.fi-warning` `.fi-error` `.fi-info`
- parts: `.icon-tile` `.icon-tile-accent`

```html
<div class="cluster gap-4">
  <svg class="fi fi-xl fi-accent" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-brain"/></svg> <svg class="fi fi-xl" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-database"/></svg> <svg class="fi fi-xl fi-success" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-check-circle"/></svg> <svg class="fi fi-xl fi-warning" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-warning"/></svg> <svg class="fi fi-xl fi-error" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-x-circle"/></svg>
  <span class="icon-tile icon-tile-accent"><svg class="fi fi-lg" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-sparkle"/></svg></span>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Decorative icons: aria-hidden="true". Meaningful standalone icons: role="img" + aria-label, or a visible label.

---

## Spinner  ·  Core
Indeterminate loading indicator.

- base: `.spinner`
- sizes: `.spinner-xs` `.spinner-sm` `.spinner-md` `.spinner-lg` `.spinner-xl`
- variants: `.spinner-accent`

```html
<div class="cluster gap-4" role="status" aria-label="Loading">
  <span class="spinner spinner-xs"></span><span class="spinner spinner-sm"></span><span class="spinner"></span>
  <span class="spinner spinner-lg spinner-accent"></span><span class="spinner spinner-xl"></span>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Wrap in role="status" with a label; spinners keep rotating slowly under reduced motion so the state stays visible.

---

## Skeleton  ·  Core
Shape-preserving placeholders while content loads.

- base: `.skeleton`
- variants: `.skeleton-text` `.skeleton-title` `.skeleton-avatar` `.skeleton-block` `.skeleton-btn`

```html
<div class="card stack gap-2" role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading card">
  <div class="cluster"><span class="skeleton skeleton-avatar"></span><span class="skeleton skeleton-title"></span></div>
  <span class="skeleton skeleton-text"></span><span class="skeleton skeleton-text" style="inline-size:70%"></span>
  <span class="skeleton skeleton-btn"></span>
</div>
```

From v5: `skel-shimmer` → `skeleton`; `skel-text` → `skeleton skeleton-text`

---

## Progress  ·  Core
Determinate and indeterminate progress. Width comes from --value.

- base: `.progress`
- parts: `.progress-head` `.progress-value` `.progress-track` `.progress-fill`
- variants: `.progress-accent` `.progress-success` `.progress-warning` `.progress-error` `.progress-indeterminate`
- modifiers: `.progress-track-lg` `.progress-native`

```html
<div class="stack gap-4">
  <div class="progress progress-accent">
    <div class="progress-head"><span>DPO training</span><span class="progress-value">62%</span></div>
    <div class="progress-track" role="progressbar" aria-label="DPO training" aria-valuenow="62" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100"><div class="progress-fill" style="--value:62%"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="progress progress-success"><div class="progress-track progress-track-lg" role="progressbar" aria-label="Upload" aria-valuenow="100"><div class="progress-fill" style="--value:100%"></div></div></div>
  <div class="progress progress-indeterminate"><div class="progress-track" role="progressbar" aria-label="Queued"><div class="progress-fill"></div></div></div>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- The track carries role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow; omit valuenow for indeterminate.

---

## Status Dot  ·  Core
Tiny live-state indicators with text.

- base: `.status`
- parts: `.status-dot`
- variants: `.status-dot-success` `.status-dot-warning` `.status-dot-error` `.status-dot-info`
- modifiers: `.status-dot-pulse`

```html
<div class="stack gap-2">
  <span class="status"><span class="status-dot status-dot-success status-dot-pulse"></span>API — operational</span>
  <span class="status"><span class="status-dot status-dot-warning"></span>Benchmark — queued</span>
  <span class="status"><span class="status-dot status-dot-error"></span>GRPO stage — failed</span>
  <span class="status"><span class="status-dot"></span>Idle</span>
</div>
```

## Kbd  ·  Core
Keyboard keys and shortcuts.

- base: `.kbd`

```html
<p class="t-body-sm">Open the command palette with <kbd class="kbd">⌘</kbd> <kbd class="kbd">K</kbd></p>
```

---

## Tooltip  ·  Core
Short labels on hover and focus. Declarative via data-tooltip; rich variant for longer content.

- base: `.tooltip`
- modifiers: `.tooltip-rich`
- parts: `.tooltip-title`
- attributes: `data-tooltip`

```html
<div class="cluster">
  <button class="btn btn-icon" aria-label="Copy" data-tooltip="Copy to clipboard"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-copy"/></svg></button>
  <button class="btn btn-sm" data-tooltip="Runs SFT then DPO on the current dataset">Start training</button>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Forma.js upgrades data-tooltip into a popover linked with aria-describedby, shown on hover and keyboard focus, dismissed with Escape (WCAG 1.4.13).
- Never put essential or interactive content in a tooltip.

JS: auto `data-tooltip` · API `Forma.tooltip(el)`

---

## Code & Log  ·  Core
Code blocks with a copy action, inline code, and terminal/log output.

- base: `.code-block`
- parts: `.code-block-head` `.code-copy` `.code-inline` `.log` `.log-line` `.log-time` `.log-info` `.log-ok` `.log-warn` `.log-error` `.tok-k` `.tok-s` `.tok-c` `.tok-n` `.tok-t`
- attributes: `data-forma="copy"`

```html
<div class="stack gap-4">
  <div>
    <div class="code-block-head"><span>index.html</span><button class="code-copy" data-forma="copy" data-copy-target="#code-ex">Copy</button></div>
    <pre class="code-block" id="code-ex"><code><span class="tok-c">&lt;!-- one stylesheet --&gt;</span>
&lt;link rel=<span class="tok-s">"stylesheet"</span> href=<span class="tok-s">"forma.min.css"</span>&gt;</code></pre>
  </div>
  <pre class="log"><span class="log-line"><span class="log-time">09:14:02</span><span class="log-info">INFO</span> Training started — Qwen3-14B</span>
<span class="log-line"><span class="log-time">09:22:41</span><span class="log-ok">OK  </span> Checkpoint saved</span>
<span class="log-line"><span class="log-time">09:23:12</span><span class="log-warn">WARN</span> VRAM 74.8 / 80 GB</span>
<span class="log-line"><span class="log-time">09:41:03</span><span class="log-error">ERR </span> Disk full — retrying</span></pre>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Copy buttons announce "Copied" through the shared live region.

JS: auto `data-forma="copy"` · API `Forma.copy(text)`

---

## Field  ·  Forms
Label, control, hint and message as one accessible unit. Validation state lives on the control via aria-invalid.

- base: `.field`
- parts: `.field-label` `.field-label-row` `.field-hint` `.field-message` `.field-counter` `.fieldset` `.form-grid` `.span-all` `.form-actions`
- variants: `.field-message-error` `.field-message-success` `.field-message-warning`
- modifiers: `.field-required`

```html
<form class="stack gap-5" data-forma="validate" novalidate>
  <div class="form-grid">
    <div class="field">
      <label class="field-label" for="f-name">Model name</label>
      <input class="input" id="f-name" name="name" required minlength="3" placeholder="forge-14b" aria-describedby="f-name-hint">
      <p class="field-hint" id="f-name-hint">Letters, numbers and hyphens.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="field">
      <label class="field-label" for="f-mail">Contact e-mail</label>
      <input class="input" id="f-mail" type="email" name="email" required placeholder="you@studio.com">
    </div>
    <div class="field span-all">
      <div class="field-label-row"><label class="field-label" for="f-desc">Description</label><span class="field-counter" data-counter-for="f-desc">0 / 280</span></div>
      <textarea class="textarea" id="f-desc" maxlength="280" placeholder="What does this model do?"></textarea>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="form-actions"><button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost">Cancel</button><button class="btn btn-primary">Save</button></div>
</form>
```

Accessibility:
- Every control has a <label for>.
- Hints and messages are connected with aria-describedby; Forma.validate wires this automatically.
- Errors set aria-invalid="true" — color is never the only signal (icon + text).

From v5: `field-wrap` → `field`; `form-row form-row-2` → `form-grid`; `field-msg field-msg-error` → `field-message field-message-error`; `field-error (on wrapper)` → `aria-invalid="true" on the control`

---

## Input  ·  Forms
Text input, textarea and native select. Sizes, addons, icons, search.

- base: `.input`
- parts: `.textarea` `.select` `.input-group` `.input-addon` `.input-addon-plain` `.search`
- sizes: `.input-sm` `.input-lg` `.select-sm` `.select-lg`
- states: `aria-invalid` `.disabled` `.readonly`

```html
<div class="grid" style="--min:220px">
  <div class="field"><label class="field-label" for="i1">Website</label><div class="input-group"><span class="input-addon">https://</span><input class="input" id="i1" placeholder="studio.com"></div></div>
  <div class="field"><label class="field-label" for="i2">Budget</label><div class="input-group"><input class="input" id="i2" inputmode="decimal" value="1,200"><span class="input-addon">USD</span></div></div>
  <div class="field"><label class="field-label" for="i3">Medium</label><select class="select" id="i3"><option>Oil on canvas</option><option>Digital</option><option>Mixed media</option></select></div>
  <div class="field"><label class="field-label" for="i4">Search</label><div class="search"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-search"/></svg><input class="input" id="i4" type="search" placeholder="Search works"><kbd class="kbd">/</kbd></div></div>
  <div class="field"><label class="field-label" for="i5">Small</label><input class="input input-sm" id="i5" placeholder="Small"></div>
  <div class="field"><label class="field-label" for="i6">Disabled</label><input class="input" id="i6" disabled value="Locked"></div>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Placeholder is never a label.
- Textareas grow with content (field-sizing) up to 320px.

From v5: `input-addon-wrap` → `input-group`; `search-field` → `search`; `select-wrap > select.select` → `select.select`

## Checkbox & Radio  ·  Forms
Native inputs, restyled. Indeterminate state, descriptions, and selectable cards.

- base: `.checkbox`
- parts: `.radio` `.check` `.check-desc` `.choice-group` `.choice-group-row` `.choice-card` `.choice-card-body` `.choice-card-title` `.choice-card-desc` `.choice-card-meta`

```html
<div class="grid-2">

    <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" checked> Training complete</label>
    <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" data-indeterminate> Some evals</label>
    <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox"><span>Weekly digest<span class="check-desc">Every Monday, 09:00</span></span></label>
    <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" disabled> Disabled</label>
  </fieldset>
  <fieldset class="choice-group"><legend class="field-label">Visibility</legend>
```

Accessibility:
- Real <input type="checkbox|radio">: native keyboard, forms and screen-reader support.
- Group with <fieldset><legend>.

- data-indeterminate sets the indeterminate property via Forma.js.

From v5: `checkbox + checkbox-box span` → `<label class="check"><input class="checkbox">`; `radio-card / checkbox-card / opt` → `choice-card`

## Range  ·  Forms
Native range slider with filled track; dual-thumb min/max via Forma.js.

- parts: `.range-scale` `.range-output` `.range-dual`

```html
<div class="stack gap-5">
  <div class="field"><div class="field-label-row"><label class="field-label" for="r1">Temperature</label><output class="range-output" for="r1">0.7</output></div>
    <input type="range" class="range" id="r1" min="0" max="2" step="0.1" value="0.7" data-forma="range"><div class="range-scale"><span>0</span><span>1</span><span>2</span></div></div>
  <div class="field"><div class="field-label-row"><span class="field-label" id="r2l">Price</span><output class="range-output">$20 – $80</output></div>
    <div class="range-dual" data-forma="range-dual" role="group" aria-labelledby="r2l"><input type="range" class="range" min="0" max="100" value="20" aria-label="Minimum price"><input type="range" class="range" min="0" max="100" value="80" aria-label="Maximum price"></div></div>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Each thumb is a real range input with its own label.
- Dual range: the two inputs share one track, so their boxes overlap; each thumb stays individually operable by pointer and keyboard (arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home/End).

JS: auto `data-forma="range" | "range-dual"`

## Validation  ·  Forms
Native constraint validation, enhanced: inline messages, an error summary, password strength. Messages in English and Turkish.

- base: `.form-summary`
- parts: `.form-summary-title` `.strength` `.strength-bar` `.strength-label`
- attributes: `data-forma="validate"` `data-strength`

```html
<div class="stack gap-4">
  <div class="form-summary" role="alert" tabindex="-1"><p class="form-summary-title">2 fields need attention</p><ul><li><a href="#f-name">Model name is required</a></li><li><a href="#f-mail">Enter a valid e-mail</a></li></ul></div>
  <div class="field"><label class="field-label" for="pw">Password</label><input class="input" id="pw" type="password" data-strength aria-describedby="pw-s">
    <div class="strength" id="pw-s" data-score="3" aria-live="polite"><span class="strength-bar"></span><span class="strength-bar"></span><span class="strength-bar"></span><span class="strength-bar"></span><span class="strength-label">Good</span></div></div>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Uses the browser constraint API (required, type, minlength, pattern) — no custom rule syntax to learn.
- On submit, focus moves to the summary; each entry links to its field.
- Messages are localised: Forma.validate.locale = "tr".

JS: auto `data-forma="validate"` · API `Forma.validate(form) · Forma.validate.messages.tr` · events `forma:invalid` `forma:valid`

From v5: `data-validate="required|email"` → `native required / type="email"`; `pw-strength` → `strength`

## Dialog  ·  Overlays
Modal dialogs on native <dialog>: real focus trap, inert page, Escape, top layer, animated entry and exit.

- base: `.dialog`
- sizes: `.dialog-sm` `.dialog-lg` `.dialog-xl`
- parts: `.dialog-header` `.dialog-title` `.dialog-desc` `.dialog-body` `.dialog-footer` `.dialog-close` `.dialog-icon` `.dialog-icon-error` `.dialog-icon-warning` `.dialog-icon-accent`
- attributes: `data-forma-open="id"` `data-forma-close`

```html
<div class="cluster">
  <button class="btn btn-primary" data-forma-open="dlg-train">Start training</button>
  <button class="btn btn-destructive" data-forma-open="dlg-delete">Delete account</button>
</div>
<dialog class="dialog" id="dlg-train" aria-labelledby="dlg-train-t" aria-describedby="dlg-train-d">
  <header class="dialog-header"><div><h2 class="dialog-title" id="dlg-train-t">Start training</h2><p class="dialog-desc" id="dlg-train-d">Estimated ≈ 5 hours · ≈ $45</p></div><button class="dialog-close" data-forma-close aria-label="Close"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-x"/></svg></button></header>
  <div class="dialog-body">
    <div class="field"><label class="field-label" for="dlg-name">Run name</label><input class="input" id="dlg-name" value="forge-14b-dpo" autofocus></div>
    <div class="field"><label class="field-label" for="dlg-base">Base model</label><select class="select" id="dlg-base"><option>Qwen3-14B</option><option>Qwen3-8B</option></select></div>
  </div>
  <footer class="dialog-footer"><button class="btn btn-ghost" data-forma-close>Cancel</button><button class="btn btn-accent" data-forma-close="launch">Launch</button></footer>
</dialog>
<dialog class="dialog dialog-sm" id="dlg-delete" role="alertdialog" aria-labelledby="dlg-del-t" aria-describedby="dlg-del-d">
  <div class="dialog-header"><div><span class="dialog-icon dialog-icon-error"><svg class="fi fi-lg" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-trash"/></svg></span><h2 class="dialog-title" id="dlg-del-t">Delete account?</h2><p class="dialog-desc" id="dlg-del-d">All models and datasets are removed permanently. This cannot be undone.</p></div></div>
  <footer class="dialog-footer"><button class="btn btn-ghost" data-forma-close autofocus>Keep account</button><button class="btn btn-danger" data-forma-close="delete">Delete</button></footer>
</dialog>
```

Accessibility:
- Opened with showModal(): focus is trapped, the page behind is inert, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger.
- Destructive confirms use role="alertdialog" and autofocus the safe action.
- data-forma-close="value" sets dialog.returnValue; listen to the native close event.

JS: auto `data-forma-open / data-forma-close` · API `Forma.dialog.open(id) · Forma.dialog.close(id, value) · Forma.confirm({ title, text, danger }) → Promise<boolean>`

From v5: `modal-wrap > modal / modal-hd / modal-bd / modal-ft` → `dialog.dialog / dialog-header / dialog-body / dialog-footer`; `alert-dialog` → `dialog.dialog-sm[role=alertdialog]`

## Drawer & Sheet  ·  Overlays
Side drawers and bottom sheets — the same native dialog, different entrance.

- base: `.drawer`
- modifiers: `.drawer-start`
- parts: `.sheet` `.sheet-handle`

```html
<div class="cluster">
  <button class="btn" data-forma-open="drw-filters"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-filter"/></svg> Filters</button>
  <button class="btn" data-forma-open="sht-share"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-share"/></svg> Share</button>
</div>
<dialog class="dialog drawer" id="drw-filters" aria-labelledby="drw-t">
  <header class="dialog-header"><h2 class="dialog-title" id="drw-t">Filters</h2><button class="dialog-close" data-forma-close aria-label="Close"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-x"/></svg></button></header>
  <div class="dialog-body"><fieldset class="choice-group"><legend class="field-label">Status</legend><label class="check"><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" checked> Running</label><label class="check"><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox"> Queued</label><label class="check"><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox"> Done</label></fieldset></div>
  <footer class="dialog-footer"><button class="btn btn-ghost" data-forma-close>Reset</button><button class="btn btn-primary" data-forma-close>Apply</button></footer>
</dialog>
<dialog class="dialog sheet" id="sht-share" aria-labelledby="sht-t">
  <span class="sheet-handle" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  <header class="dialog-header"><h2 class="dialog-title" id="sht-t">Share run</h2><button class="dialog-close" data-forma-close aria-label="Close"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-x"/></svg></button></header>
  <div class="dialog-body"><div class="input-group"><input class="input" readonly value="https://nage.ai/r/forge-14b" aria-label="Link"><button class="btn btn-sm" data-forma="copy" data-copy-text="https://nage.ai/r/forge-14b">Copy</button></div></div>
</dialog>
```

Accessibility:
- Same guarantees as Dialog. Drawers mirror automatically in RTL.

From v5: `drawer (static demo)` → `dialog.dialog.drawer`; `bottom-sheet` → `dialog.dialog.sheet`; `mobile-drawer` → `dialog.dialog.drawer.drawer-start`

---

## Popover  ·  Overlays
Non-modal floating panels on the native Popover API — light-dismiss and Escape built in. Positioned to the trigger by Forma.js.

- base: `.popover`
- parts: `.popover-title`
- attributes: `popover` `popovertarget`

```html
<button class="btn" popovertarget="pop-about">About Forge-14B</button>
<div class="popover" id="pop-about" popover>
  <p class="popover-title">Forge-14B</p>
  <p>AI engineering assistant on Qwen3-14B. Trained with SFT + DPO across five domains.</p>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- popovertarget wires aria-expanded on the trigger automatically.
- Forma.js flips the panel when it would overflow the viewport.

JS: auto `[popover]` · API `Forma.position(panel, trigger, { placement })`

From v5: `popover-wrap > popover-box popover-bottom` → `[popover].popover + popovertarget`

---

## Menu  ·  Overlays
Action menus: popover + role="menu" with roving focus, type-ahead, checkable items and shortcuts.

- base: `.menu`
- modifiers: `.menu-static`
- parts: `.menu-item` `.menu-item-danger` `.menu-shortcut` `.menu-separator` `.menu-label`

```html
<button class="btn" popovertarget="menu-actions" aria-haspopup="menu">Actions <svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-chevron-down"/></svg></button>
<div class="menu" id="menu-actions" popover role="menu" aria-label="Actions">
  <p class="menu-label">Run</p>
  <button class="menu-item" role="menuitem"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-edit"/></svg> Rename <span class="menu-shortcut">⌘E</span></button>
  <button class="menu-item" role="menuitem"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-copy"/></svg> Duplicate <span class="menu-shortcut">⌘D</span></button>
  <button class="menu-item" role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked="true"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-bell"/></svg> Notify on finish</button>
  <hr class="menu-separator">
  <button class="menu-item menu-item-danger" role="menuitem"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-trash"/></svg> Delete <span class="menu-shortcut">⌘⌫</span></button>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Arrow keys / Home / End move focus, type-ahead jumps, Escape closes and returns focus, Tab leaves.
- Context menus: data-forma="context-menu" data-menu="id" opens the menu at the pointer.

JS: auto `[role=menu][popover]` · API `Forma.menu(el)`

From v5: `menu > menu-content.is-open + Forma.toggleMenu()` → `[popover].menu + popovertarget`; `menu-item.is-danger` → `menu-item menu-item-danger`; `context-menu` → `menu menu-static`

⌘K / Ctrl+K launcher with fuzzy filtering, groups and keyboard navigation.

- base: `.command`
- parts: `.command-input` `.command-list` `.command-group` `.command-item` `.command-item-icon` `.command-item-desc` `.command-footer` `.command-empty`

```html
<button class="btn" data-forma-open="cmdk"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-search"/></svg> Search… <kbd class="kbd">⌘K</kbd></button>
<dialog class="dialog command" id="cmdk" data-forma="command" data-hotkey="mod+k" aria-label="Command palette">
  <div class="dialog-body">
    <div class="command-input"><svg class="fi fi-lg" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-search"/></svg><input placeholder="Type a command or search…" aria-label="Search commands"></div>
    <div class="command-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Commands">
      <p class="command-group">Quick actions</p>
      <div class="command-item" role="option"><span class="command-item-icon"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-plus"/></svg></span><span>Create new model <span class="command-item-desc">Forge, Fehm or Cortex</span></span></div>
      <div class="command-item" role="option"><span class="command-item-icon"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-upload"/></svg></span><span>Upload dataset <span class="command-item-desc">CSV, JSONL, Parquet</span></span></div>
      <div class="command-item" role="option"><span class="command-item-icon"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-play"/></svg></span><span>Start training</span></div>
      <p class="command-group">Navigate</p>
      <div class="command-item" role="option"><span class="command-item-icon"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-chart-bar"/></svg></span><span>Analytics</span></div>
      <div class="command-item" role="option"><span class="command-item-icon"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-settings"/></svg></span><span>Settings</span></div>
      <p class="command-empty" hidden>No results.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="command-footer"><span><kbd class="kbd">↑</kbd><kbd class="kbd">↓</kbd> navigate</span><span><kbd class="kbd">↵</kbd> select</span><span><kbd class="kbd">esc</kbd> close</span></div>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

Accessibility:
- Input owns the list via aria-activedescendant; results count is announced.

JS: auto `data-forma="command"` · events `forma:command`

## Toast  ·  Overlays
Transient notifications in a polite live region. Pause on hover/focus, actions, auto-dismiss.

- base: `.toast`
- variants: `.toast-success` `.toast-error` `.toast-warning` `.toast-info`
- parts: `.toast-region` `.toast-body` `.toast-title` `.toast-text` `.toast-action` `.toast-close` `.toast-timer`
- modifiers: `.toast-static`

```html
<div class="cluster">
  <button class="btn" onclick="Forma.toast.success('Changes saved', 'Your settings were updated.')">Success</button>
  <button class="btn" onclick="Forma.toast.error('Upload failed', 'File exceeds the 10 MB limit.')">Error</button>
  <button class="btn" onclick="Forma.toast({ title: 'Checkpoint deleted', action: { label: 'Undo', onClick: () => Forma.toast.info('Restored') } })">With action</button>
</div>
<div class="toast toast-static toast-success" role="status" style="margin-block-start:var(--space-4);max-inline-size:380px"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-check-circle"/></svg><div class="toast-body"><p class="toast-title">Training completed</p><p class="toast-text">forge-sft-v1 is ready for DPO.</p></div><button class="toast-close" aria-label="Dismiss"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-x"/></svg></button></div>
```

Accessibility:
- All text is inserted with textContent — no HTML injection.
- Errors use an assertive region, everything else polite.
- Timers pause while hovered or focused (WCAG 2.2.1).

JS: API `Forma.toast({ type, title, text, duration, action, position }) · .success() .error() .warning() .info()`

From v5: `FormaToast.show({ message })` → `Forma.toast({ text })`

Top application bar: brand, primary links, actions. Sticky translucent variant.

- base: `.navbar`
- modifiers: `.navbar-sticky`
- parts: `.navbar-brand` `.navbar-nav` `.navbar-link` `.navbar-end` `.navbar-toggle` `.navbar-collapse`

```html
<nav class="navbar" aria-label="Main">
  <a class="navbar-brand" href="#">Forma</a>
  <ul class="navbar-nav navbar-collapse">
    <li><a class="navbar-link" href="#" aria-current="page">Dashboard</a></li>
    <li><a class="navbar-link" href="#">Models</a></li>
    <li><a class="navbar-link" href="#">Datasets</a></li>
    <li><a class="navbar-link" href="#">Evals</a></li>
  </ul>
  <div class="navbar-end">
    <button class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" data-forma-open="cmdk"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-search"/></svg><kbd class="kbd">⌘K</kbd></button>
    <button class="btn btn-icon btn-ghost btn-sm" aria-label="Notifications"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-bell"/></svg></button>
    <button class="btn btn-icon btn-ghost btn-sm navbar-toggle" aria-label="Menu"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-menu"/></svg></button>
    <span class="avatar avatar-sm avatar-accent">ÖA</span>
  </div>
</nav>
```

Accessibility:
- <nav aria-label> landmark; the current page uses aria-current="page".
- Below 880px .navbar-collapse hides and .navbar-toggle opens a drawer.

- states: `data-collapsed`

```html
<nav class="sidebar" aria-label="Workspace" id="sb-demo" style="block-size:380px">
  <div class="sidebar-header"><span class="avatar avatar-sm avatar-square avatar-accent">N</span><span class="sidebar-label t-body-sm">Nage Workspace</span></div>
  <a class="sidebar-item" href="#" aria-current="page"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-home"/></svg><span class="sidebar-label">Overview</span></a>
  <p class="sidebar-section">Models</p>
  <a class="sidebar-item" href="#"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-box"/></svg><span class="sidebar-label">Forge</span><span class="sidebar-count">3</span></a>
  <a class="sidebar-item" href="#"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-box"/></svg><span class="sidebar-label">Fehm</span><span class="sidebar-count">1</span></a>
  <p class="sidebar-section">Data</p>
  <a class="sidebar-item" href="#"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-database"/></svg><span class="sidebar-label">Datasets</span><span class="sidebar-count">12</span></a>
  <div class="sidebar-footer"><button class="sidebar-item" data-forma="sidebar-toggle" data-target="sb-demo" aria-expanded="true"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-sidebar"/></svg><span class="sidebar-label">Collapse</span></button></div>
</nav>
```

Accessibility:
- Collapsed items keep their accessible names (labels are hidden visually only by display:none → use title/tooltip: Forma.js adds data-tooltip from the label).

JS: auto `data-forma="sidebar-toggle"`

From v5: `sidebar-collapsible.is-collapsed` → `sidebar[data-collapsed]`; `nav-tabs-v` → `tabs tabs-vertical`

## Tabs  ·  Navigation
WAI-ARIA tabs in four looks: line, underline, pill, vertical. Arrow keys, Home/End, automatic activation.

- base: `.tabs`
- variants: `.tabs-underline` `.tabs-pill` `.tabs-vertical`
- parts: `.tab-list` `.tab` `.tab-panel`

```html
<div class="stack gap-6">
  <div class="tabs" data-forma="tabs">
    <div class="tab-list" role="tablist" aria-label="Run details">
      <button class="tab" role="tab" aria-selected="true">Overview</button>
      <button class="tab" role="tab">Data</button>
      <button class="tab" role="tab">Analysis <span class="badge">3</span></button>
      <button class="tab" role="tab">Settings</button>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-panel" role="tabpanel">Key metrics, recent activity and system status.</div>
    <div class="tab-panel" role="tabpanel" hidden>Tables and filters.</div>
    <div class="tab-panel" role="tabpanel" hidden>Charts and insights.</div>
    <div class="tab-panel" role="tabpanel" hidden>Configuration.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tabs tabs-pill" data-forma="tabs">
    <div class="tab-list" role="tablist" aria-label="Filter"><button class="tab" role="tab" aria-selected="true">All</button><button class="tab" role="tab">Active</button><button class="tab" role="tab">Archived</button></div>
    <div class="tab-panel" role="tabpanel">All runs.</div><div class="tab-panel" role="tabpanel" hidden>Active runs.</div><div class="tab-panel" role="tabpanel" hidden>Archived runs.</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Forma.js wires ids, aria-controls, aria-labelledby and tabindex; only the selected tab is in the Tab order.
- Panels toggle with the hidden attribute, never inline styles.

JS: auto `data-forma="tabs"` · API `Forma.tabs(el).select(index)` · events `forma:tab`

From v5: `tab-item.is-active + switchTab(group, i, el)` → `tab[aria-selected] (automatic)`; `tab-list-pill / tab-item-pill` → `tabs tabs-pill`; `tab-list-underline` → `tabs tabs-underline`

## Wizard  ·  Navigation
Multi-step form: steps + panels + navigation. Validates each panel before advancing.

- base: `.wizard`
- parts: `.wizard-panel` `.wizard-nav` `.wizard-count`
- attributes: `data-wizard-next` `data-wizard-prev`

```html
<form class="wizard card" data-forma="wizard" novalidate>
  <ol class="steps"><li class="step"><span class="step-title">Account</span></li><li class="step"><span class="step-title">Profile</span></li><li class="step"><span class="step-title">Review</span></li></ol>
  <section class="wizard-panel stack"><div class="field"><label class="field-label" for="wz-mail">E-mail</label><input class="input" id="wz-mail" type="email" required></div></section>
  <section class="wizard-panel stack" hidden><div class="field"><label class="field-label" for="wz-name">Display name</label><input class="input" id="wz-name" required></div></section>
  <section class="wizard-panel" hidden><p class="t-body-sm t-secondary">All set. Submit to create your workspace.</p></section>
  <div class="wizard-nav"><button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-wizard-prev>Back</button><span class="wizard-count" aria-live="polite"></span><button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-wizard-next>Continue</button></div>
</form>
```

Accessibility:
- Focus moves to the first field of each new panel; the step counter is announced.

JS: auto `data-forma="wizard"` · API `Forma.wizard(el) → { next, prev, go(i), index }` · events `forma:step`

From v5: `FormaWizard(el)` → `Forma.wizard(el)`

## Data Table  ·  Data
Semantic tables with toolbar, sortable headers (aria-sort), row selection, sticky header, striped/compact, and stack-on-narrow.

- base: `.table`
- parts: `.table-wrap` `.table-toolbar` `.table-title` `.table-footer` `.sort-btn` `.num` `.muted` `.cell-strong`

```html
<div class="table-wrap cq">
  <div class="table-toolbar"><h3 class="table-title">Training runs</h3><div class="search"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-search"/></svg><input class="input input-sm" type="search" placeholder="Filter" aria-label="Filter runs" data-table-filter></div><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-plus"/></svg> New run</button></div>
  <table class="table table-hover table-stack" data-forma="table">
    <thead><tr>
      <th scope="col"><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" aria-label="Select all" data-select-all></th>
      <th scope="col" aria-sort="none"><button class="sort-btn">Model</button></th>
      <th scope="col">Stage</th>
      <th scope="col" class="num" aria-sort="none"><button class="sort-btn">Loss</button></th>
      <th scope="col" class="num">Duration</th>
      <th scope="col">Status</th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" aria-label="Select Forge-14B"></td><td data-label="Model" class="cell-strong">Forge-14B</td><td data-label="Stage" class="muted">DPO</td><td data-label="Loss" class="num">0.41</td><td data-label="Duration" class="num">4h 22m</td><td data-label="Status"><span class="status"><span class="status-dot status-dot-warning status-dot-pulse"></span>Running</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" aria-label="Select Cortex-14B"></td><td data-label="Model" class="cell-strong">Cortex-14B</td><td data-label="Stage" class="muted">SFT</td><td data-label="Loss" class="num">0.68</td><td data-label="Duration" class="num">—</td><td data-label="Status"><span class="status"><span class="status-dot"></span>Queued</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" aria-label="Select Fehm-8B"></td><td data-label="Model" class="cell-strong">Fehm-8B</td><td data-label="Stage" class="muted">SFT + DPO</td><td data-label="Loss" class="num">0.34</td><td data-label="Duration" class="num">5h 14m</td><td data-label="Status"><span class="status"><span class="status-dot status-dot-success"></span>Done</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" aria-label="Select Conflux-v1"></td><td data-label="Model" class="cell-strong">Conflux-v1</td><td data-label="Stage" class="muted">GRPO</td><td data-label="Loss" class="num">1.82</td><td data-label="Duration" class="num">1h 03m</td><td data-label="Status"><span class="status"><span class="status-dot status-dot-error"></span>Failed</span></td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  <div class="table-footer"><span data-table-status>4 runs</span><span>Page 1 of 1</span></div>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Sorting updates aria-sort on the <th>; the sort control is a real button.
- Row selection mirrors aria-selected on the <tr>.
- .table-stack turns rows into labelled cards inside narrow containers (uses data-label).

JS: auto `data-forma="table"` · events `forma:sort` `forma:select`

From v5: `data-table-wrap / data-table` → `table-wrap / table`; `dt-sort-btn.is-sorted` → `th[aria-sort] > .sort-btn`; `compare-table` → `table`

## KPI  ·  Data
Headline numbers with trend and optional sparkline, in a responsive grid.

- base: `.kpi`
- parts: `.kpi-grid` `.kpi-label` `.kpi-value` `.kpi-foot`

```html
<div class="kpi-grid">
  <div class="kpi"><span class="kpi-label">Monthly revenue</span><span class="kpi-value">$48,210</span><span class="kpi-foot"><span class="metric-delta" data-trend="up">12.4%</span> vs last month</span><svg class="sparkline" data-forma="sparkline" data-values="12,14,13,17,16,19,22,21,25" role="img" aria-label="Revenue trend, rising"></svg></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="kpi-label">Active users</span><span class="kpi-value">3,847</span><span class="kpi-foot"><span class="metric-delta" data-trend="up">8.1%</span> this week</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="kpi-label">Churn</span><span class="kpi-value">2.3%</span><span class="kpi-foot"><span class="metric-delta" data-trend="up">−0.5 pt</span> improvement</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="kpi-label">NPS</span><span class="kpi-value">72</span><span class="kpi-foot"><span class="metric-delta">0.0</span> no change</span></div>
</div>
```

From v5: `kpi-card / kpi-trend kpi-up / kpi-delta kpi-delta-up` → `kpi / metric-delta[data-trend=up]`

```html
</ol>
```

```html
<ul class="feed">

</ul>
```

## Kanban  ·  Data
Columns of cards with drag-and-drop and a keyboard alternative (Space to lift, arrows to move).

- parts: `.kanban-col` `.kanban-head` `.kanban-count` `.kanban-card` `.kanban-card-title` `.kanban-card-meta` `.kanban-add`

```html
<div class="kanban" data-forma="kanban">
  <section class="kanban-col" aria-label="Backlog"><h3 class="kanban-head">Backlog <span class="kanban-count">2</span></h3>
    <article class="kanban-card" tabindex="0"><p class="kanban-card-title">Redesign onboarding</p><p class="kanban-card-meta"><span class="badge badge-info">Design</span>NGA-145</p></article>
    <article class="kanban-card" tabindex="0"><p class="kanban-card-title">Migrate legacy API</p><p class="kanban-card-meta"><span class="badge">Backend</span>NGA-142</p></article>
    <button class="kanban-add"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-plus"/></svg> Add card</button></section>
  <section class="kanban-col" aria-label="In progress"><h3 class="kanban-head">In progress <span class="kanban-count">1</span></h3>
    <article class="kanban-card" tabindex="0"><p class="kanban-card-title">Token engine dark-mode refresh</p><p class="kanban-card-meta"><span class="badge badge-accent">CSS</span>NGA-138</p></article></section>
  <section class="kanban-col" aria-label="Done"><h3 class="kanban-head">Done <span class="kanban-count">1</span></h3>
    <article class="kanban-card" tabindex="0"><p class="kanban-card-title">Wizard component</p><p class="kanban-card-meta"><span class="badge badge-success">Done</span>NGA-130</p></article></section>
</div>
```

Accessibility:
- Keyboard: focus a card, Space to lift, ←/→ to change column, Space to drop, Escape to cancel; moves are announced.

From v5: `kanban-board / kanban-column` → `kanban / kanban-col`

## Tree View  ·  Data
Hierarchies — files, schemas, taxonomies — with the WAI-ARIA tree pattern.

- base: `.tree`
- parts: `.tree-item` `.tree-meta`

```html
<ul class="tree" role="tree" aria-label="Schema" data-forma="tree">
  <li role="treeitem" aria-expanded="true"><span class="tree-item"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-database"/></svg> nage_prod</span>
    <ul role="group">
      <li role="treeitem" aria-expanded="true"><span class="tree-item"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-table"/></svg> runs <span class="tree-meta">4.2K</span></span>
        <ul role="group"><li role="treeitem"><span class="tree-item">id <span class="tree-meta">uuid</span></span></li><li role="treeitem" aria-selected="true"><span class="tree-item">loss <span class="tree-meta">float8</span></span></li></ul></li>
      <li role="treeitem" aria-expanded="false"><span class="tree-item"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-table"/></svg> datasets <span class="tree-meta">312</span></span><ul role="group"><li role="treeitem"><span class="tree-item">name</span></li></ul></li>
    </ul></li>
</ul>
```

Accessibility:
- Arrow keys move/expand/collapse; Home/End; Enter selects. Forma.js manages roving tabindex.

JS: auto `data-forma="tree"` · events `forma:select`

## Chart Container  ·  Charts
The frame every chart sits in: title, headline value, canvas, legend, table toggle, tooltip. Series colors --data-1…8 are CVD-validated and stay the same across themes.

- base: `.chart`
- parts: `.chart-head` `.chart-title` `.chart-subtitle` `.chart-value` `.chart-canvas` `.chart-legend` `.chart-swatch` `.chart-swatch-line` `.chart-tooltip` `.s-1` `.s-2` `.s-3` `.s-4` `.s-5` `.s-6` `.s-7` `.s-8` `.s-accent` `.s-muted`

```html
<figure class="chart" data-forma="chart" data-type="line" data-labels="Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri,Sat,Sun"
  data-series='[{"name":"Forge","values":[1.84,1.52,1.21,0.98,0.76,0.54,0.34]},{"name":"Fehm","values":[1.6,1.41,1.2,1.08,0.9,0.81,0.7]}]' data-format="0.00">
  <figcaption class="chart-head"><div><p class="chart-title">Training loss</p><p class="chart-subtitle">Last 7 epochs</p></div><p class="chart-value">0.34</p></figcaption>
  <div class="chart-canvas"></div>
</figure>
```

Accessibility:
- Each SVG gets role="img" and an aria-label summary; Forma.chart also renders a visually hidden data table, and a "Show data" toggle on request.
- Two or more series always get a legend; up to four are also direct-labelled.
- Hover and keyboard focus (arrow keys) drive the tooltip and crosshair.
- Never two y-axes.

JS: auto `data-forma="chart" data-type="line|area|bar|donut|gauge"` · API `Forma.chart(el, { type, labels, series, format })`

---

## Bar Chart  ·  Charts
CSS-only vertical bars for small series (no JS), or Forma.chart type="bar" for grouped bars with axes.

- base: `.bars`
- parts: `.bars-item` `.bars-fill` `.bars-label`
- attributes: `--value` `data-muted`

```html
<figure class="chart"><figcaption class="chart-head"><p class="chart-title">Runs per day</p><p class="chart-value">96</p></figcaption>
  <div class="bars" role="img" aria-label="Runs per day: Mon 8, Tue 12, Wed 18, Thu 14, Fri 22, Sat 6, Sun 16">
    <div class="bars-item"><div class="bars-fill" style="--value:36%"></div><span class="bars-label">Mon</span></div>
    <div class="bars-item"><div class="bars-fill" style="--value:55%"></div><span class="bars-label">Tue</span></div>
    <div class="bars-item"><div class="bars-fill" style="--value:82%"></div><span class="bars-label">Wed</span></div>
    <div class="bars-item"><div class="bars-fill" style="--value:64%"></div><span class="bars-label">Thu</span></div>
    <div class="bars-item"><div class="bars-fill" style="--value:100%"></div><span class="bars-label">Fri</span></div>
    <div class="bars-item" data-muted><div class="bars-fill" style="--value:27%"></div><span class="bars-label">Sat</span></div>
    <div class="bars-item" data-muted><div class="bars-fill" style="--value:73%"></div><span class="bars-label">Sun</span></div>
  </div></figure>
```

From v5: `bar-chart / bar-col / bar-fill` → `bars / bars-item / bars-fill`

From v5: `h-bar-list / h-bar-item` → `hbars / hbar`

## Donut  ·  Charts
Part-to-whole for up to five parts, with center total and legend.

- base: `.donut`
- parts: `.donut-seg` `.donut-track` `.donut-center` `.donut-center-label`

```html
<figure class="chart" data-forma="chart" data-type="donut" data-labels="Turkish,English,Mixed,Other" data-series='[{"values":[45,35,15,5]}]' data-center="200K" data-center-label="samples" data-format="0'%'">
  <figcaption class="chart-head"><p class="chart-title">Dataset language mix</p></figcaption><div class="chart-canvas"></div></figure>
```

Accessibility:
- Segments are separated by a 2px gap; the legend lists values, never color alone.

---

## Gauge  ·  Charts
A single value against a range (0–100 by default), with threshold coloring.

- base: `.gauge`
- parts: `.gauge-track` `.gauge-fill` `.gauge-value` `.gauge-label`

```html
<div class="cluster gap-6">
  <div class="gauge" data-forma="chart" data-type="gauge" data-value="84" data-label="Eval score"></div>
  <div class="gauge" data-forma="chart" data-type="gauge" data-value="94" data-label="VRAM" data-warn="80" data-danger="90"></div>
</div>
```

```html
<div class="card metric" style="max-inline-size:260px"><span class="metric-label">Tokens / day</span><span class="metric-value">2.4M</span><svg class="sparkline" data-forma="sparkline" data-values="8,9,7,11,12,10,14,16,15,19,21,24" role="img" aria-label="Tokens per day, rising from 0.8M to 2.4M"></svg></div>
```

```html
</div><div class="heatmap-legend">Less <i class="heatmap-cell" data-level="0"></i><i class="heatmap-cell" data-level="1"></i><i class="heatmap-cell" data-level="2"></i><i class="heatmap-cell" data-level="3"></i><i class="heatmap-cell" data-level="4"></i><i class="heatmap-cell" data-level="5"></i> More</div></div>
```

```html
<div class="product-grid">

    <div class="product-body"><a class="product-name" href="#">Minimal leather bag</a><p class="product-desc">Hand-stitched natural leather, fits 15″.</p><div class="rating"><span class="rating-stars" style="--rating:4.5" role="img" aria-label="4.5 out of 5"></span>(48)</div>
      <div class="swatches" role="group" aria-label="Colour"><button class="swatch" style="--_c:#2b2118" aria-label="Espresso" aria-pressed="true"></button><button class="swatch" style="--_c:#a8784f" aria-label="Tan" aria-pressed="false"></button></div>
      <div class="product-foot"><span class="price"><span class="price-current">$129</span></span><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">Add to cart</button></div></div></article>
  <article class="product"><div class="product-media"><svg class="fi fi-2xl fi-tertiary" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-headphones"/></svg><span class="badge badge-error product-flag">−30%</span></div>
    <div class="product-body"><a class="product-name" href="#">Wireless headphones Pro</a><p class="product-desc">ANC, 40-hour battery.</p><div class="rating"><span class="rating-stars" style="--rating:4" role="img" aria-label="4 out of 5"></span>(124)</div>
      <div class="product-foot"><span class="price"><span class="price-current">$245</span><span class="price-old">$350</span></span><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">Add to cart</button></div></div></article>
```

Accessibility:
- The name link stretches over the card; inner buttons stay independently clickable.

## Prose  ·  Content

- parts: `.lead` `.dropcap`

```html
<div class="prose">
  <p class="lead">Typography is the craft of making written language legible, readable and appealing.</p>
  <p class="dropcap">It is not only a choice of typeface. It is hierarchy, rhythm, and the management of space — the interval between letters, lines and ideas. <a href="#">Read more about rhythm</a>.</p>
  <h2>A system, not a style</h2>
  <p>Cormorant carries the display voice; Syne handles the interface; JetBrains Mono marks metadata. <strong>Each has one job.</strong></p>
  <ul><li>Measure stays near 68 characters.</li><li>Headings balance their lines.</li><li>Paragraphs avoid orphans.</li></ul>
</div>
```

## Chat  ·  AI
A complete assistant surface: log, empty state with suggestions, messages, composer. Auto-scroll, Enter to send, Shift+Enter newline.

- base: `.chat`
- parts: `.chat-log` `.chat-empty` `.chat-empty-title` `.suggestions` `.suggestion`

```html
<section class="chat" data-forma="chat" style="block-size:520px" aria-label="Assistant">
  <div class="chat-log" role="log" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="message message-user"><div class="message-body"><p>Show me how to use the KPI component.</p></div></div>
    <div class="message"><span class="message-avatar" aria-hidden="true">AI</span><div class="message-body">
      <p>Wrap cards in <code>.kpi-grid</code> — it auto-fits columns:</p>
      <pre class="code-block"><code>&lt;div class="kpi"&gt;
  &lt;span class="kpi-label"&gt;MRR&lt;/span&gt;
  &lt;span class="kpi-value"&gt;$48,210&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;</code></pre>
      <div class="citations"><a class="citation" href="#"><span class="citation-index">1</span><span>FORMA docs · KPI</span></a></div>
      <div class="message-actions"><button class="btn btn-icon btn-ghost btn-sm" aria-label="Copy" data-forma="copy"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-copy"/></svg></button><button class="btn btn-icon btn-ghost btn-sm" aria-label="Retry"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-refresh-cw"/></svg></button><button class="btn btn-icon btn-ghost btn-sm" aria-label="Good response"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-thumbs-up"/></svg></button></div>
    </div></div>
    <div class="message"><span class="message-avatar" aria-hidden="true">AI</span><div class="message-body"><span class="thinking"><span class="thinking-dots" aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span><span></span></span><span class="thinking-shimmer">Thinking…</span></span></div></div>
  </div>
  <form class="composer"><label class="sr-only" for="cmp">Message</label><textarea class="composer-input" id="cmp" rows="1" placeholder="Ask anything…"></textarea>
    <div class="composer-bar"><button type="button" class="btn btn-icon btn-ghost btn-sm" aria-label="Attach file"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-paperclip"/></svg></button><select class="select" aria-label="Model"><option>forge-14b</option><option>fehm-8b</option></select><button class="btn btn-icon btn-accent btn-sm composer-send" aria-label="Send"><svg class="fi" aria-hidden="true"><use href="forma-icons.svg#fi-arrow-up"/></svg></button></div></form>
</section>
```

Accessibility:
- The log is role="log" aria-live="polite": new assistant messages are announced once complete, not per token.
- Forma.chat.add() inserts text with textContent; pass { html } only for trusted, sanitised markup.

JS: auto `data-forma="chat"` · API `Forma.chat(el) → { add({ role, text, html }), thinking(), stream(text|AsyncIterable), clear() }` · events `forma:submit`

From v5: `chat-container / chat-messages` → `chat / chat-log`; `chat-bubble-user / chat-bubble-ai` → `message message-user / message`

```html
2
3</span><pre class="query-code" contenteditable="true" spellcheck="false" role="textbox" aria-multiline="true" aria-label="SQL"><span class="tok-k">SELECT</span> model, <span class="tok-k">avg</span>(loss)
```
